displayAddress: Lansdowne Court, 83 Lansdowne Road, Bournemouth, Dorset, BH1
description:
Set within a charming character building conversion, this spacious first-floor studio apartment offers a fantastic investment opportunity, available with a tenant in situ, providing immediate rental income. Ideally located close to the town centre, with excellent transport links and easy access to nearby beaches, this well-proportioned home combines convenience with attractive period charm.
The apartment is accessed via internal stairs leading up to a split-level entrance hall, which adds a touch of architectural interest upon arrival. From here, the property opens into a generous studio room, notable for its dual aspect windows that fill the space with natural light and provide a bright, welcoming atmosphere.
The separate kitchen is both functional and thoughtfully laid out, featuring matching cupboards at base and eye level, ample work surface, and an inset sink. Integrated appliances include a gas hob, electric oven, and extractor hood, with space for an upright fridge/freezer and plumbing in place for a washing machine—ideal for modern living.
The bathroom is fitted with a matching three-piece suite, comprising a panelled bath with shower attachment, wash hand basin, and WC, all presented in a clean, neutral style.
Additional benefits of this property include an allocated parking space, well-maintained communal gardens, and a secure bike shed, enhancing both practicality and lifestyle appeal for residents.
This apartment is part of a converted period building that retains original character while offering the comfort and functionality of a contemporary home. Its prime location, combined with strong rental demand in the area, makes it an ideal choice for investors looking to expand their portfolio with a ready-to-go, income-generating asset.
